metric: Median of five interleaved full compute trajectories; setup, planning, callback calibration, detection, native integration and final readout included; installation, JIT warmup, shared initial-state generation and disk I/O excluded.
numba_warmup: Both arms explicitly warmed per case; raw report records cost.

interpretation: Sustained sparse invariant-subspace examples benefit. Random cases are essentially unchanged; no general CFD speedup demonstrated.
